title: PyNetDesign: a Python framework for microseismic monitoring network design
description: PyNetDesign is an open-source Python library that provides a simple and functional framework for designing and testing microseismic monitoring networks. Version 1.1.0 adds phase-resolved wave modes, so that SV and SH are treated separately with their own root-mean-square radiation patterns; receiver projection computed from the arriving polarization vectors, which is correct for inclined and curved cables and for single vertical-component stations; a free surface correction applied per receiver rather than to the whole network; synthetic geometry builders for borehole, surface and dark-fibre layouts, with writers to save and decimate them; a documentation site in HTML and PDF with a methodology chapter and an example gallery; and branding. S-wave results differ from 1.0.x because the S branch now uses the phase-resolved radiation patterns instead of the combined value.
